question: 昨天支付订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS pay_order_cnt FROM dwd_shop.dwd_order_detail_di WHERE pay_status = 1 AND dt BETWEEN '{date_start}' AND '{date_end}' LIMIT 200

question: 上周销售额
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gmv FROM dwd_shop.dwd_order_detail_di WHERE pay_status = 1 AND dt BETWEEN '{date_start}' AND '{date_end}' LIMIT 200

question: 客单价
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM dwd_shop.dwd_order_detail_di WHERE pay_status = 1 AND dt BETWEEN '{date_start}' AND '{date_end}' LIMIT 200

question: 最近7天每天的支付订单数
sql: SELECT dt, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS pay_order_cnt FROM dwd_shop.dwd_order_detail_di WHERE pay_status = 1 AND dt BETWEEN '{date_start}' AND '{date_end}' GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt LIMIT 200

question: 本周每个品类的销量
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS sales_volume FROM dwd_shop.dwd_order_detail_di WHERE dt BETWEEN '{date_start}' AND '{date_end}' AND category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY sales_volume DESC LIMIT 200

question: 各渠道的支付订单数
sql: SELECT c.channel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS pay_order_cnt FROM dwd_shop.dwd_order_detail_di o JOIN dwd_shop.dim_channel c ON o.channel = c.channel_name WHERE o.pay_status = 1 AND o.dt BETWEEN '{date_start}' AND '{date_end}' GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY pay_order_cnt DESC LIMIT 200
